data.titleEn: L'ORÉAL PARIS C'EST MAGIC BB CREAM VARIOUS SHADES
data.name: L'ORÉAL PARIS C'EST MAGIC BB CREAM VARIOUS SHADES
data.description: Protect and perfect your complexion with the L'Oreal Paris C'est Magic BB Cream. This ultra-lightweight formula evens out the skin tone for a natural looking, flawless finish. The BB cream is infused with mineral pigments which are released upon application to match the skin’s unique texture and tone. Discover the most seamless match yet with this your-skin-but-better formula. The multi-tasking BB cream combines a natural finish foundation with skincare benefits to provide long lasting hydration. Glycerin creates a weightless texture with up to 24 hours of hydration while a refreshing antioxidant mix of Fig extract, Pro-vitamin B5 and Vitamin E help to protect your skin from environmental stress. The BB cream provides essential SPF20 protection from UVA and UVB rays to help protect the skin from sun damage and premature ageing. Care for your skin while creating a naturally perfected complexion with this multi-benefit BB cream!
